 Jasleen Taneja Updated: Nov 9, 2026, 23:21 IST IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 out at ibps.in The IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 is released on the official website, http://www.ibps.in. The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection has activated the prelims call letter for 4,256 Officers Scale-I posts.
 Candidates who have successfully registered for the prelims exam scheduled for November 21 and 22, 2026 can now download the admit card using their registration number and password/DOB.
 The IBPS RRB PO admit card 2026 is a mandatory document and contains details like candidate’s roll number, exam date, shift, reporting time and exam centre address. Candidates must carry a printed copy with a valid photo ID to the exam hall, as entry is not allowed without them.
 On this page, we have shared details like IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 direct download link, steps to download, details mentioned on it, documents required, and more.
 The IBPS RRB PO 2026 Call Letter is now live on the official candidate portal for the CRP RRBs-XV Officers Scale-I prelims. Candidates appearing for the prelims exam are advised to download the call letter as soon as possible to avoid web traffic or server issues. 
 The hall ticket can be downloaded from the official portal using the registration number and password/DOB.
 The selection process comprises Prelims, Mains, and Interview. The prelims will be conducted on November 21 and 22, 2026. The Mains exam will be held on December 20, 2026.
 IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 Download link
 The direct link to download the IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 is active. Candidates need to log in with their registration/roll number and password/DOB. For the ease of candidates, we have provided the direct download link below:
 IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 Download Link(ACTIVE) 
 Steps to download RRB PO Call Letter
 Candidates can follow this method to download the hall ticket from the official portal:
 Visit the official website www.ibps.in .
 Click on the 'CRP RRBs' tab on the homepage.
 Select 'Common Recruitment Process for Regional Rural Banks Phase XV'.
 Click on the link 'Online Preliminary Exam Call Letter for Officer Scale I'.
 Enter the Registration/Roll Number and Password/Date of Birth with the captcha code.
 Click on submit and the admit card will appear on the screen.
 Details mentioned on the RRB PO Hall Ticket
 Candidates should verify the following details mentioned on the call letter. In case of any errors, authorities should be informed immediately.
 Candidate’s name and photograph
 Roll number and registration number
 Date of birth and category
 Exam name and post applied for
 Exam date, shift and reporting time
 Exam centre name and full address
 Important exam day instructions
 Documents to carry on exam day
 Candidates should keep these documents with them on the day of the exam:
 Printed Copy of IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026
 Original Valid Photo ID
 Copy of Original Valid Photo ID
 Passport-size photographs
 What if you're unable to download IBPS RRB PO Admit Card?
 If candidates face any issues while downloading the admit card, they should try the steps shared below:
 Use the 'Forgot Password' option or log in with your date of birth.
 Enter the registration/roll number without spaces and fill the captcha carefully.
 Clear the browser cache or try another browser or device.
 Avoid peak hours and retry after some time.
